decision.explanation: The question asks for the establishment date of 'Gibraltar Barracks'. The source documents describe three distinct military installations sharing this name in different locations: 1) Gibraltar Barracks in Bury St Edmunds (Documents 1, 2, 3), established/opened in 1878. 2) Gibraltar Barracks in Northampton (Documents 5, 6), where permanent barracks were first established around 1797 (renamed Gibraltar Barracks later, but the entity 'Gibraltar Barracks' in the context of the Northampton entry often refers to the site's history starting then). 3) Gibraltar Barracks in Minley (Document 7), established in the early 1970s. The answer '1797' (C3) is a less precise version of 'around 1797' (C1) found in the same context; 'around 1797' is preferred as it matches the source text exactly. All three distinct dates correspond to valid, separate referents for the named entity 'Gibraltar Barracks'.
